All three bugs are fixed and verified. Here's a summary of the changes:

## 1. Prototype-pollution safety in `updateProjectManifestObject`
**`pkg-manifest/utils/src/updateProjectManifestObject.ts`**
- Added a `setDependency` helper that stores aliases via `Object.defineProperty` (enumerable/writable/configurable data property) instead of direct `obj[alias] = spec` assignment. This prevents the `__proto__` setter from firing and keeps `Object.prototype` untouched. Applied at all three write sites (saveType, peerDependencies, bareSpecifier).
- Hardened `guessDependencyType` and `findSpec` to use `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(...)` so inherited members (`constructor`, `toString`, etc.) aren't mistaken for existing own dependencies.

Verified: aliases stored as own props, prototype chain still points to `Object.prototype`, and `Object.prototype` is unmodified.

## 2. `RegistryResponseError` hint (linear time)
**`resolving/npm-resolver/src/fetch.ts`**
- Removed the catastrophic-backtracking `semverRegex` and replaced it with `stripVersionSuffix`, which uses `indexOf('@', 1)` (skips the leading scope `@`) + `slice`.
- `lodash@4.17.21` → "Did you mean lodash?"; `@scope/foo@1.2.3` → "Did you mean @scope/foo?"; bare versions / no-suffix names / non-404 responses → no suggestion; 10,000-char input resolves in ~0.01ms.

## 3. Scoped-package slash encoding for visibility URL
**`releasing/commands/src/publish/oidc/provenance.ts`**
- Replaced `npa(packageName).escapedName` (which only encoded the first `/`) with `packageName.replace(/\//g, '%2f')`, encoding every slash.
